comparison.objective: These rows pursue assembly, fastening, inspection, cutting, loading, cleaning, care, material handling, or other endpoints rather than turning a pizza approximately 180 degrees in place inside a roofed oven.
comparison.physical_skill: None tests the candidate's combined ability to steer a full-scale long-handled turning peel through an oven mouth, insert its thin blade beneath a compliant crust rim, and apply repeated low-lift tangential strokes while preserving pizza-to-stone contact and suppressing center drift.
comparison.success_condition: Their endpoints do not jointly require released pizza yaw of 150–210 degrees, no more than 50 mm trajectory-wide center excursion, uninterrupted deck contact, top-side-up oven containment, no crust or topping damage, and complete peel withdrawal.
comparison.reason: Although individual rows share generic primitives such as tool use, rotation, force control, confined insertion, food handling, or clean release, their objectives, essential contact mechanics, and scored outcomes are all materially different from centered peel-mediated pizza turning.
